messages:
sophia: Quick follow-up from the midnight postmortem: transient probe failures + immediate cipher fallback routed traffic to an older pool, which amplified client retries and spiked tail latency. Posting concrete owners and short/long term steps. Pls ack and update ETAs.

oncall-bot: Postmortem available: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-23-probe-cipher-fallback (tags: lb, tls, dns, postmortem)

omar: Saw the logs. The region affinity probe window was too tight (100ms) and we flip to SNI fallback on the first unexpected response. Two things to change: (1) add a probe backoff and (2) make fallback hysteresis configurable.

nina: I'll take the hysteresis work. Plan: add a 10s soft-fallback window, then a hard-fallback after 30s of consecutive failures. Flow: staging -> canary -> prod. ETA: 2026-04-01.

bryce: I'll do probe backoff tuning and add a per-route probe timeout override. Also adding a metric emit when fallback is triggered so we can alert on it. ETA: 2026-03-29 EOD.

netops: Recommend a short mitigation during cert rotations: suspend immediate cipher-suite fallback for 3m windows and increase probe timeout to 500ms. Ops caveat: this can mask unhealthy backends temporarily. Need owners to sign off.

sophia: If we take the mitigation, require: (a) rollback flag, (b) alert: retry_rate_by_region > 2% sustained 3m, (c) automatic rollback if 5xx increases by 0.8% in 5m.

omar: I'll add the rollback toggle to the runbook automation. ETA: 2026-03-26 COB.

nina: can we add a small smoke that forces a forced-region header and verifies selected pool? Example: 
```
# force-region-smoke.sh
for r in us-east eu-west ap-sg; do
  curl -s -H "X-Force-Region: $r" https://edge.redwood.ai/health | jq -r .selected_pool || echo "fail $r"
 done
```
We can run this as part of canary gating.

bryce: good. I'll add a Prometheus panel for fallback_count and retry_amplification_ratio. Also scheduling a 6-week regression triage: Mon 14:00 UTC starting 2026-03-30.

sophia: action items recap:
- NINA: implement fallback hysteresis + runbook updates (owner) 1 ETA 2026-04-01
- BRYCE: probe backoff tuning + dashboard panels (owner) 1 ETA 2026-03-29 EOD
- OMAR: rollback toggle automation + preflight checks (owner) 1 ETA 2026-03-26 COB
- NETOPS: coordinate cert-rotation mitigation window with cert-team (owner) 1 scheduled discussion 2026-03-25

netops: Invite sent to lb/tls/dns/oncall for the weekly check-ins.

sophia: thanks. Please update the postmortem doc with PR links and mark anything that should escalate to the weekly triage. I'll close this thread after a 24h stable canary. :white_check_mark:
